title: Prove shortest-query thin-call bounds and finite-period rigidity
body:
A full query caller with n independent fields and n+1 rank-one central queries cannot use arbitrary scalar frames to avoid every thin call. This package proves exact minimum counts 1, 2 and 3 for n=4, 6 and 8, and checks the unique alternating pattern at each minimum. A complete query normal form and projector chart make the 84 symbolic domains exhaustive under the stated contract.

The finite-period theorem closes a proposed escape: if the stage period p is at least n-1 and every character occurs, the shortest all-full query identity implies the formal identity. The literal native order-seven cell has all seven characters, so the eight-field/nine-full proposal is excluded. The package also gives a short four-field polynomial contradiction valid outside characteristic two and a sharp signed five-versus-six-call bound at every coupled width.

**No new κ.** Extra queries, initialized work, shorter periods and noncentral native frames remain open. The alternating constructions satisfy the full query polynomial but their natural stage endpoint has a nonzero Jordan defect. Discovery failures are recorded separately and are not universal exclusions.

[Proof and package](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/075c9df913cfabcbaa84d1d71e8561b20141b856/research/five-call-projector-rigidity) · [Finite-period proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/075c9df913cfabcbaa84d1d71e8561b20141b856/research/five-call-projector-rigidity/PERIOD.md) · [Validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/075c9df913cfabcbaa84d1d71e8561b20141b856/research/five-call-projector-rigidity/VALIDATION.md) · [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5593#discussioncomment-19199752).

Validation: registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays pass, including exact algebra, complete positive controls and semantic rejection controls. Committed bytes, executable modes, official export and declared-input coverage pass. An optimized replay of the read-only Git-free export passed with an empty PATH; all 45 exported files and modes were unchanged. Full-history preflight was unavailable in the shallow checkout; direct base ancestry and the two base-source pins passed. The validation receipt was added after the checked export without changing proof or executable files. Hosted CI and independent scientific review remain pending. The selected frontier replay was not run.

Base: canonical main 3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839, priority revision 8. This leaves the selected frontier and other constructions unchanged. Credit Cinna Davis's query/controller lineage, the retained P104/native contributors, and the earlier public connector research; border comparisons credit Dillon and Yiyang.
